inputs.name: createRemotePhoneStore.workspace
inputs.description: The existing Workspace whose remote phone control port and project state this store reads and updates. The factory keeps this workspace reference and does not accept a phone port separately.

outputs.name: createRemotePhoneStore
outputs.description: A new RemotePhoneState instance bound to the supplied Workspace and exposed through the RemotePhone type. It holds remote phone status, error, busy, and scan-failure state and acts through the workspace remote phone port.
